# Run book: Compare two texts with embeddings

[Run books](README.md) | [User guide](../user-guide/compare-two-texts.md) | [Spec](../specs/compare-two-texts.md)

## Contents

- [Purpose](#purpose)
- [Preconditions](#preconditions)
- [Verify](#verify)
- [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting)

## Purpose

Turn text into vectors and measure similarity in process, the basis of semantic search, deduplication and clustering without a remote service.

## Preconditions

- The all-MiniLM embedder is available in the API.

## Verify

Automatically: `npx playwright test e2e/journeys.spec.ts -g "Compare two texts with embeddings"` (add `E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8088` to run against the compose stack).

By hand, in the example web application at `/ai/embeddings`:

1. **Enter two texts.** Choose the model and type the two sentences to compare. Expect: Both text boxes hold the entered sentences.
2. **Embed and compare.** The screen shows the vector size, the cosine similarity (1 means identical meaning) and the first values of the vector. Expect: Dimensions shows 384. A cosine similarity is displayed.

## Troubleshooting

**Table 1 — Known problems**

| Symptom | Likely cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| First call is slow | The ONNX model is downloaded on first use into the hub cache | Wait once; later calls are fast |
| Download fails | No internet access for the first download | Provide the model files in the shared hub cache folder |

Related framework features: OoBDev.Onnx.SentenceEmbeddings; OoBDev.AI.Abstractions (`IEmbeddingProvider`).
